title: Virus IgM Antibody Detection
author: Wenjing Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdasi2ee

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Plates
steps.instruction: Equilibrate all reagent components and samples to room temperature (25 °C) and mix them prior to the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Unpack microplates and place the required amount of strips in the holder.
Seal remaining strips in the packaging bag and store at 2-8℃.

steps.title: Dilute Samples and Controls
steps.instruction: Dilute specimens and quality controls using the provided sample diluent or normal saline.

substeps.instruction: For cerebrospinal fluid: dilute 1:10 with normal saline.
For serum: dilute 1:100 (or 1:101, e.g., 10 µL serum + 1000 µL diluent) with normal saline or sample diluent.
For quality controls: dilute 100-fold with sample diluent (e.g., 4 µL control + 396 µL diluent in a 1.5 ml EP tube).

steps.title: Load Samples and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add diluted specimens and controls to the microplate and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL (or 100 µL depending on version) of diluted serum, cerebrospinal fluid, positive quality control, and negative quality control to corresponding wells.
Set one well as a blank control.
Seal the plate with sealant plywood on the open microwell surface.
Incubate at 37℃ for 1 hour.

steps.title: First Wash Cycle
steps.instruction: Wash the microwells to remove unbound materials.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Fill each well with washing solution, allow to stand for 30 seconds, and shake to dryness; repeat 4 times.
Option B: Wash six times with 1X washing solution on a plate washer (300 µL per well each time).
Pat residual liquid in the wells on absorbent paper.

steps.title: Add Antigen and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add the antigen-enzyme conjugate or specific antigens to the wells.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Add 50 µL of JE antigen-enzyme conjugate mixture to each well (except blank wells).
Option B: Add 50 µL JERA to one set of specimens and 50 µL NCA to another set of identical specimens.
Option C: Add 100 µL of antigen.
Seal the plate and incubate at 37℃ for 1 hour (or 120 minutes depending on version).

steps.title: Second Wash Cycle
steps.instruction: Wash the microwells again to remove unbound antigen.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Fill each well with washing solution, allow to stand for 30 seconds, and shake to dryness; repeat 4 times.
Option B: Wash six times with 1X washing solution on a plate washer (300 µL per well each time).
Pat residual liquid in the wells on absorbent paper.

steps.title: Add Enzyme Conjugate and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add the horseradish peroxidase (HRPO) labeled conjugate to the wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of HRPO horseradish peroxidase-labeled enzyme conjugate (or 100 µL IgM Conjugate) to each well.
Seal the plate and incubate at 37℃ for 1 hour (or 30 minutes depending on version).

steps.title: Third Wash Cycle and EnWash
steps.instruction: Perform final washing and optional EnWash step.

substeps.instruction: Wash six times with 1X washing solution on a plate washer (300 µL per well each time) and pat dry.
Add 150 µL of EnWash solution to each well.
Incubate at room temperature (uncovered) for 5 minutes.
Wash six times with 1X washing solution on a plate washer (300 µL per well each time) and pat dry.

steps.title: Add Chromogen and Develop
steps.instruction: Add substrate to develop the color reaction.

substeps.instruction: Option A: Add 1 drop of chromogenic solution A and 1 drop of chromogenic solution B to each well, mix, and react at 37℃ (protected from light) for 10 minutes. For visual determination, allow 10 minutes at room temperature (20-28℃) in the dark.
Option B: Add 75 µL of TMB substrate solution using a multichannel pipette and incubate at room temperature in the dark for 10 minutes.
Option C: Add 100 µL of enzyme substrate (Substrate Reagent) and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Stop Reaction and Read
steps.instruction: Stop the enzymatic reaction and measure the optical density.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 drop (or 50 µL / 100 µL) of stop solution to each well.
If using 50 µL stop solution, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Measure the OD value of each well at 450 nm.
